newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close sharply down in technical trade.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close sharply down in technical trade.

text.p: FCOJ futures closed sharply weaker for the second consecutive session amid brisk speculative selling that pressured most of the board to lifetime lows, dealers said.

The spot July contract settled 1.90 cents weaker at 72.65 cents per lb, traded 75.25 to a life-of-contract low of 71.30 cents. September ended down 1.40 cents at 75.50 cents, while the rest of the board went out 1.35 to 2.65 lower.

Despite the ongoing negative fundamental situation, today's losses were blamed on technical factors. The July contract took out several key support levels at 74.00, 73.00, and then 72.00 cents, triggering sell stops along the way that attracted additional selling.
The trade remained a steady buyer and is expected to hold the front month at 70.00 cents, where the market should begin to stage a correction.
Open interest in the July contract fell by 1,781 lots to stand at 12,890 lots.
The first notice day for the contract is July 1.
An estimated 8,000 lots changed hands on the day, compared with Friday's official 5,365 lots.
